title: Singularities of Time-Optimal Trajectories
exact_target: Is every individual time-optimal trajectory of a generic three-dimensional system piecewise smooth, and is switching complexity locally finite at every point? Do analytic systems always admit optimal connections with at most countably many switches?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 6500001 (AMR-064-0001). CC BY 4.0.
A. A. Agrachev, \emph{Some open problems}, arXiv:1304.2590v2 (2013), Section I, pp. 1--3.
